notes.title: Virtual Reality + Price Drop
notes.content:
I have some major news regarding the latest update:

[list]
[*] Strange Aeons now has an optional Virtual Reality mode, with both Windows and Linux supported through OpenXR.
[*] The price is dropped from $11.99 to $8.99 (the specific amount will vary depending on regional pricing). The players who bought the game before this price decrease will receive copies of my two earlier games (Desert of Vice and Ladderhead). I also want to thank you so much for supporting the game early on!
[*] The mirrors in the library scene look much nicer, some rare visual glitches were fixed as well.
[/list] 

If you're curious about the VR version, here's a new gameplay trailer:

[previewyoutube=0K3r_apZhmc;full]Virtual Reality Trailer[/previewyoutube]

notes.title: November Update
notes.content:
Let me briefly touch upon the things that I've been working on since the last update:
[olist][*][u]November Update[/u]
This past month I mostly worked on polishing visuals and small improvement, the biggest of which was the redesigned look of keyboard input. Now the text you enter is displayed like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37641665/53e550f791f82bd7277aa9143784d2d31c8a2ddc.gif[/img]
[/*][*][u]Gamedev videos[/u]
I started making short vertical videos about how the features and plugins created for the game were made. I post these videos on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VE1dYAKs1-s&list=PLM9Q5ZxUo0PhDXjUtuRv2r63WB8uuX2o1]Youtube[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@tiesiogkarolis]TikTok[/url].

I have already made tutorials on the following topics:

notes.title: October Update
notes.content:
It's been a while since I last shared an update of the game on Steam, so here I go, I'm spilling the beans:

[olist]
[*] The most significant feature included since the start of Summer is the ability to see the text that the parser has recognized.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37641665/8dc50295def82089279a9e8140aebde5dd9a94f7.gif[/img]
[*] There's an official [url=https://discord.com/invite/7HRyvd6sf9]Discord server[/url] to follow development now
[url=https://discord.com/invite/7HRyvd6sf9][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37641665/56eced2238aeac0317861baf1a68ab8b4bb07a30.png[/img][/url]
[*] Strange Aeons will be part of Steam Scream Fest. I plan to stream the game, so be sure to check it out.
[/olist]

Also, the game is pretty much completed. It's going to come out real soon.
